_internalReasoning: Extracted all visible menu items from Cafe Crisan, clustered beverages by sugar content and preparation, aligned with user profile excesses.
comparisonTitle: Cafe Crisan Beverage & Dessert Menu Evaluation
summary: The menu primarily features sweet iced beverages and fruit juices high in added sugars, which conflict with the user's current added sugar and calorie overages. Plain water, unsweetened tea, and black coffee serve as the safest choices, whereas heavy condensed milk and fruit-syrup bowls represent severe metabolic risks.

groups.groupName: Tier 1 - Safest Choice: Unsweetened Hot Beverages
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike the sugary fruit juices and dessert bowls, black coffee contains zero added sugar and minimal calories.
groups.message: This unsweetened hot beverage option is ideal for managing caloric intake and avoiding added sugars. While it lacks macronutrients, it provides antioxidants without aggravating your current calorie and sugar excesses.
groups.orderingTip: Order plain black coffee or tea without any added sugar or condensed milk.

groups.groupName: Tier 2 - Moderate Choice: Lightly Sweetened & Fresh Hydration
groups.comparisonSentence: These beverages offer moderate hydration benefits but contain added sweeteners that contribute to carbohydrate overloads.
groups.message: Options like sweet tea and young coconut water offer refreshing hydration and trace electrolytes like potassium. However, added sugars and simple carbohydrates contribute directly to your daily carbohydrate and added sugar overages.
groups.orderingTip: Request half-sugar or no added syrup to minimize carbohydrate impact.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Caution Choice: Fruit Juices & Sweet Iced Drinks
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to plain beverages, these fruit juices and jellies deliver a significant surge in fructose and liquid calories.
groups.message: Fruit juices and flavored iced beverages provide vitamins, potassium, and dietary fibre depending on the pulp content. Conversely, they pack concentrated liquid fructose and added sugars that worsen your existing added sugar and carbohydrate excesses.
groups.orderingTip: Choose fresh fruit juices without added simple syrup and limit portion sizes.

groups.groupName: Tier 4 - Severe Metabolic Load: Mixed Dessert Bowls & Syrups
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike simple fruit juices, these loaded dessert bowls combine heavy condensed milk, fruit syrups, and high-fat avocado or durian.
groups.message: These dessert beverages offer dietary fibre from mixed fruits and healthy monounsaturated fats from avocado. However, heavy condensed milk, palm syrups, and high sugar content severely exacerbate your added sugar, saturated fat, and calorie excesses.
groups.orderingTip: Avoid entirely or share with multiple people, requesting no condensed milk or heavy syrups.
